newsitem.title: ITALY: EIB lira bond may be upped by 250 bln lire-Paribas.
newsitem.headline: EIB lira bond may be upped by 250 bln lire-Paribas.

text.p: The European Investment Bank's euro-tributary eurobond, raised on Thursday to 1.25 trillion lire from 1.0 trillion, could be upped by a further 250 billion lire to 1.5 trillion lire, Robert Ricci, director general of Banque Paribas Italia, told a news conference.
"We are willing to take the issue to 1.5 trillion lire," Ricci said.
The lira leg of the EIB's benchmark euro Eurobond was launched on Tuesday. Paribas, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro (BNL) and Credito Italiano were joint lead managers.
"The success of the issue's increase demonstrates the market's confidence in Italy's entry to the single European currency," said Davide Croff, BNL managing director. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
